text.description_html:
Michael Healy MH1003, Oversized Butterfly Door Knocker

The Nickel Silver Butterfly Door Knocker is oversized, measuring 7-1/4 inches tall and 7 inches wide. This Large Silver Butterfly Door Knocker is sure to make a beautiful statement on any door. It is made from sandcast brass and has a nickel silver finish. It comes packaged with all the necessary mounting hardware.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

The Nickel Silver Finish is created by combining polished nickel with satin highlights that accent this front door knocker's details for a contemporary look.

Also Available Polished Brass and Satin Bronze Butterfly Door Knocker

Features and Specifications of the Butterfly Front Door Knocker:

  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Finish: Nickel Silver
  • Height: 7-1/4"
  • Width: 7"
  • Mounting Hole Centers: 1-13/16"
  • Projection Off Door: 1-3/4"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
